tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// rdo rje phur bu yang gsang spu gri'i las byang kun bzang rol mtsho zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

oṃ swasti/ rdo rje phur bu yang gsang spu gri'i las byang kun bzang rol mtsho zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo// mi 'gyur bde chen rdo rje phur bu yis// stong nyid 'khor lor rgyas 'debs he ru ka /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med lhag pa'i lhar// 'dud do dngos grub gnas la gegs med mdzod// rig mchog 'bum sde'i snying po kī la ya// yang gsang spu grir 'brel ba'i 'phrin las gzhung*// kun bzang rol mtsho'i 'jings las grub gnyis kyi// 'dod 'jo'i rin chen gter gyi dga' ston bya// dbang thob cing dam tshig la gnas pa'i sngags pas dben zhing mthun pa'i gnas su sku gzugs kyi rten dgram/ spyan gzigs sna tshogs pas mdzes par brgyan/ mchod gtor sogs phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig gi yo byad thams cad tshang zhing mdzes par bshams nas rnal 'byor la 'jug par bya'o// de'i rim pa ni/ ji skad du shog dril rtsa ba'i tho yig las/ bid+yot+ta ma 'bum sde'i bcud// rtsa ba yang snying drag sngags 'brel// yang gsang phur bu'i gzhung bsrang sdom// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes rim gsum// dang po mtshams bshags brda' sgo dbye// phyag 'tshal dam bca' byin dbab brlab// ces pa'i dang po sngon 'gro la chos bdun las/ dang po mtshams gcod pa ni/ rol mos byin dbab pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi sems nyid skye med chos skur dag pa'i ngang las skad cig gis dpal chen po rdo rje gzhon nu yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa'i thugs ka nas/ sprul pa'i khro tshogs phur bu 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba rnams kyis bdud bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'dus te rdo rje phur bu'i ra bas phyogs thams cad gtams par bsam la/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed// rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa// stobs chen khro bo chen po yis// klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos// steng yang phur bu'i bla re la// phur bu'i thog chen char ltar 'beb// 'og kyang phur bu'i sa gzhi la// phur bu'i 'du 'phro me ltar 'bar// phyogs mtshams phur bus gtams pa la// phur bu'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phur bu'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig

/oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ gardza/ ha na/ da ha/ pa tsa/ bhan+dha/ hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha/ tshin+da/ bhin+dha/ s+pho ṭa ya/ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mtshams gcad/ gnyis pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin rdo rje phur bu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sa mdun gyi nam mkhar sad pa'i spyan sngar 'gyod tshangs kyi bsam pa drags pos/ hūm̐/ bcom ldan bde gshegs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs// chos sku rnam dag longs sku'i dbyings nas shar// sprul sku 'gro don rdzogs mdzad phur bu'i lha// rdo rje gzhon nu sras 'khor ma lus dgongs// thog med dus nas 'khor 'das bdag gzhan tshul// chos rnams mnyam yangs spros bral ngang nyid las// las kyi dbang gis tha dad so sor bzung*// don dam dbyer med ngang du mthol lo bshags// ma rig bag nyal rnam rtog rkyen dbang gis// rgyal ba'i dgongs spyod zab mo'i gting ma rtogs// thabs dang shes rab ya bral blang dor spyod// bde gshegs bka' dang 'gal spyad mthol lo bshags// thun mong khyad par rtsa lag dam tshig rnams// ji ltar bshad pa'i gzhung bzhin ma bsrangs pa// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// gnong 'gyod drags pos mthol bshags tshangs par gsol// zhes dang spyi bshags/ hūm̐/ ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni// zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang*// thugs rje nyi gsal 'od bzhin snyoms mdzad pa// 'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs shing bzhugs su gsol// brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya che rol pa'i lha// zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// kun tu bzang po bla med mchod sprin gyis// mkha' dbyings rnam dag rgya cher yongs bkod de// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa rgya mtshos mchod// kun tu bzang mo gsang ba'i bha ga la// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus rab 'byams kun// 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang du ro gcig pa// gnyis med byang chub sems kyis mnyes gyur cig

/sems kyi rang bzhin chos dbyings nam mkha' che// chos rnams rnam dag ye nas 'od gsal zhing*// rnal 'byor nyid dbyings smra bsam las 'das pa'i// mnyam nyid byang chub sems la rtag tu 'dud// kun bzang rdzogs chen ye nas brdal ba la// phyi nang gsang ba bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i dbyings// 'byung dang 'byung gyur yab yum lhun rdzogs rnams// gsang chen rab dgyes gzugs can bdag nyid ma'i// mkha' dbyings klong yangs pad+mo 'khyil pa la// gnyis med thig le chen por 'od gsal zhing*// ma bcos spros med byang chub snying po'i sku /cir yang snang ba bde chen g.yung drung lha// 'du 'bral med pa gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag nyid chen po rigs lnga yab yum dang*// byang chub lcam dral khro bo khro mo'i tshogs// rdo rje lha mo tshogs rje tshogs kyi bdag /rigs lnga dpal chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu// gnas dang yul gyi phyag rgya sgo ma bzhi// ye shes sprul pa'i lha tshogs mang po dang*// ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung la sogs// legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma// phyi nang mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// dpang gyur rdo rje dam can dgongs su gsol// hūm̐/ thugs rje gdung 'tshob rig 'dzin bdag cag gis// 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems bskyed de// bla med go 'phang bgrod par bya ba'i phyir// bstan pa rgya mtsho so so'i 'dul khrims dang*// sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor sdom pa'i mchog /rdo rje 'da' dka' dam tshig gtan gyi gnyer// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams// snga phyir nos shing gnyer du smras so 'tshal// yun du mi gtong 'da' bar mi bgyid cing*// don las gol zhing ldog sems ma mchis kyang*// gdod bya long yod snyam pa'i le lo yis// klong du ma gyur rtsal shugs chung ba dang*// shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur te// sgom la mi brtson bsnyen sgrub g.yel la sogs// tshor dang ma tshor ma rig dbang gis na// ston pa'i bka' dang dam las 'gal gyur te// rnal 'byor gang zhig dam tshig nyams pa dang// skad cig tsam yang 'phrad par mi bya zhes// bka' las byung zhing de ltar ma lcogs te// gsang sgo 'chol bas dbye bsal dka' ba dang*// mngon shes med pas skyon can ma rtogs te// nyams dang tshogs 'dres nyams pa bskang ba dang*// nyams dang snod min rnams la chos bshad dang*// nyams la ma 'dzems nyams pa'i skyon la sogs// nyams dang 'grogs shing nyams pa de dag gi

/nyams grib skyon gyis gos par gyur to 'tshal// tshe 'di'i rkyen dang yun gyi sgrib gyur rnams// rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// byams pa'i thugs brtses bdag la dgongs nas kyang*// gnyis med dbyings su mi 'gyur bdag bkod de// dmigs med btang snyoms ngang la bzhugs nas kyang*// gnyis med don gyi tshangs pa bstsal du gsol// don dam dmigs med spros las 'das pas na// rnam rtog gang yang dmigs par mi 'gyur zhing*// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam gyi dbang gis na// nongs pa mchis na rab gnong bzod par gsol// zhes kyang bya'o// gsum pa brda' sgo dbye ba ni/ 1$0000270ma dag pa'i snang zhen thams cad sbyangs/ rdo rje phur bu rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor du tshad med pa bzhi'i 'jug pas zhugs par 1$0000300 bsam la/ hūm̐/ bde gshegs rgyal ba'i pho brang du// bdag cag dad pas 'jug 'tshal gyis// tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma bzhis// ye shes bzhi yi sgo phyes shig /oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭa/ bzhi pa brda' phyag ni/ 1$0000270dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang bdag nyid rang bzhin gnyis su med pa rang rig pa'i ngang du rtogs pas gus par 'dud 1$0000300 cing*/ hoḥ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// lha dang slob dpon rdo rje mched// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ lnga pa dam bca' ba ni/ 1$0000270'khor ba ji srid bar du gzugs kyi skus 1$0000300 1$0000270'gro don bya ba'i phyir rang bzhin chos kyi sku mngon du bya'o 1$0000300 snyam du bsam la/ hoḥ lhag pa'i lha khyod bdag la dgongs// ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs bar// rtag tu 'gro don mi skyo zhing*// byang chub sems bskyed dam bca' 'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ drug pa byin dbab pa ni/ 1$0000270nam mkha' gang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag gnas yo byad thams cad la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos la/

1$0000300 rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa'i gdung dbyangs kyis/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// gnyis med dag pa'i mkha' dbyings nas// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// dbang chen rnams kyis dbang skur cig /byin chen rnams kyis byin phob cig /mthu chen rnams kyis mthu stsol cig /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya de ba ga ṇa a dhiṣ+ṭhā na ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ zhes spos dang rol mor bcas pas dbab bo// bdun pa mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas mchod rdzas kyi nyes skyon dngos 'dzin bag chags dang bcas pa bsregs gtor bkrus te dag par byas/ slar yang thugs ka nas oṃ dkar po 'phros/ bdud rtsi'i steng gi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi 'od zer 'bar bas rdzas rang ga ma'i rtog pa sbyangs/ āḥdamar po 'phros ye shes kyi mer 'bar bas bag chags ngan pa'i gnyis rtog bsregs/ hūm̐ mthing ga 'phros ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bas bdud rtsi ro mchog brgya dang ldan pa rigs lnga yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar ro gcig pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ yang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas ra yig dmar po 'phros rak+ta'i steng gi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi 'od zer 'bar bas 'khor ba rgyun gcod kyi rak+ta'i rgya mtsho kha zhag dang bcas pa sha chen gyi lhu dum gyis brgyan pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam la/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nyer gcig brjod/ yang*/ rang gi thugs ka nas bh+rūm̐ 'phros gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkha' la ye shes kyi 'od zer 'bar bas gtor gzhong rin po che'i gzhal yas khang sa gzhi dang mnyam pa'i nang du/

gtor ma 'dod yon lnga'i phung po nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam la/ oṃ kha ta li bh+rūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta āḥ zhes nyer gcig gis byin gyis brlabs la/ hūm̐/ rtog bral ye shes bdud rtsi 'bar// chags med rak+ta'i rgya mtsho 'khyil// 'dod yon lnga yi gtor chen spungs// kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas gsal gdab bo// spyi don gnyis pa la/ dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rang bzhin las// zhes pas rnam pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang*/ rang bzhin ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ thog mar ting gsum 'byung rim brtseg /gzhal yas gdan bcas rten gnas su// rtsa ba khro bcu phur bu rdzas// sgo skyong srung ma'i tshogs bskyed bya// zhes don brgyad du gsungs pa las/ dang po ting 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub pa ni/ chos thams cad rang sems kyi snang ba tsam du rdzogs pa'i stong pa nyid kyi rdo rje so so rang rig pa'i ngo bor 'bar zhing 'phros pas zhe sdang la sogs pa dug lnga'i rnam rtog gnas su gcod pa de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rigs drug gi sdug bsngal rtsa ba nas gcod par bya'o snyam du snying rje'i mtshon cha chen po sems can gyi khams thams cad du khyab par 'bar ba kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin dang*/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa nam mkha'i dbyings nas sems kyi rten dwangs ma'i srog hūm̐ yig sngon po thig le'i ngo bo nyid du shar ba rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod// mtshon chen sngon po 'bar ba yis// nam mkha'i dkyil nas thigs pa shar// zhes pas gsal gdab/ gnyis pa rten 'byung ba rim brtseg bsgom pa ni/ dwangs ma'i srog hūm̐ las e yaṃ raṃ suṃ keṃ raṃ rnams mched pa yongs su gyur pa las/ e las nam mkha' chos kyi 'byung gnas 'byams klas pa'i dbyings su/

yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang khu rgya gram/ raṃ las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho dmar po zlum po/ suṃ las sha chen gyi sa gzhi ser nag gru bzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab bang rim bzhi pa dkar po rnams brtseg mar gnas pa'i steng du/ raṃ las ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong chen por bsam/ gsum pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ slar yang hūm̐ las ri rab kyi steng me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du bh+rūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan mched/ bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na bhañja e maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ bh+rūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa sgo khyud glo 'bur gyi tshul can/ pho brang nang ma thod pa skam rlon rnyid pa'i rtsig pa sum rim gnam lcags kyi gzer gyis btab cing sgo khyud spangs pa'i sgo bzhi pa/ gzhal yas khang phyi ma la pha gu ser po thod pas dkrigs pa/ thod tshal gyis brgyan pa'i rgyu ma gsar pa'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ mchod rten gyi rnam pa'i pu shus bskor zhing da ru kad mi'i lag ngar ris su bres pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa bar 'dod yon gyi snam bu la mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs kyis spras pa/ sgo rgyan rta babs bzhi la rus pa'i drwa ba dang chu srin gyis brgyan pa/ steng 'og thams cad phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i kha dog can/ dbus mthing nag gru gsum zla gam dmar po thod skam gyi phreng bas zlum por bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du rin po che cha brgyad pa'i mu khyud ser po la rin po che'i phra tshom bkra ba/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi dbyibs mchod rten gyi rnam par gsal ba/ phyi rol dur khrod chen po brgyad dur khrod kyi chos rnams kyis 'jigs par byas par bsam la/ hūm̐/ rab 'jigs dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// gru gsum mthing nag zla gam rin chen 'bar// gru chad bar khyams sgo bzhi mu khyud rdzogs// ngo mtshar pho brang ye shes me 'od gsal//

zhes pas gsal gdab bo// bzhi pa gdan gsal gdab pa ni/ badz+ra ta taṃ/ lha gnas thams cad du rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i sa gzhi/ slar yang rgyu'i hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ lha chen po phyogs skyong bcu chung ma dang bcas pa bkug /so so'i gnas su 'khod pa ni/ ru dra kro dhī ti ra bam/ dbus su lha chen po/ steng du nyi zla/ shar du dri za/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan/ 'og tu sa bdag rnams rang rang gi chung ma dang bcas pa byi chings su bsnol ba'i gdan

bsam/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ gdan de rnams kyi steng du ma bcu gcig las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ nyi ma rnams kyi steng du a yig las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ zla ba rnams kyi steng du paṃ las byung ba'i pad+ma dang bcas par bsam la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje brag chen gtams pa'i sa gzhi la// dregs pa lha chen phyogs skyong pho mo bsnol// thabs shes nyi ma zla ba 'od 'bar dbus// ma chags pad+ma 'bar ba'i gdan du bsam// zhes pas gsal gdab/ lnga pa bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ nam mkha'i hūm̐ de dbus kyi gdan la skar mda' lhung ba ltar babs/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ sems can gyi don byas/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ badz+ra hūm̐/ de rdo rje rtse dgu par gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dpal chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi g.yon brkyang tshul// bzhad pa'i zhal g.yas dkar zhing g.yon dmar gshe /dbus zhal mthing nag drag tu rngam zhing 'bar// spyan dgu sdang mig khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /shangs nas hūm̐ 'byin zhal nas phaṭa sgra sgrog /rno dbal drag po'i mche ba zur gsum gtsigs// nyis khri chig stong dbu skra gyen du 'khyil// bye ba ther 'bum rdo rje'i ba spus gtams// g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse dgu gdengs// g.yon gyi dang pos me dpung 'bar ba bsnams// g.yas kyi gnyis pas rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar/ kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum g.yon gyi gnyis par 'khrol// tha ma'i phyag gnyis ri rab phur bu 'dril// rigs lnga'i rtse bran thod skam cod pan can// tshar gsum thod pa'i phreng ba ga shal bsnams// sbrul chen rigs bzhi phud sgra sgrog pas brgyan// rak+ta'i thig le zhag gi zo ris dang*// thal chen tshom bus rab brjid glang chen gyi// ko rlon zhing lpags g.yang gzhi gos su gyon// stag lpags sham thabs 'phyang zhing rdo rje yi// gshog pa gdengs pas bar snang khyab par 'gengs// mthing nag dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba'i sku

/rdo rje khro bo nyams dgus rol pa'i yum// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing ga khro zhing sgeg /g.yas pa ut+pal 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud// g.yon pas bhan dmar stob la rab brtson ma/ khro mo'i rgyan dang gzig lpags sham thabs can// bde stong sbyor bas 'bar ba'i klong na bzhugs// yab kyi thugs kar rin chen zur brgyad pa// margad gur phub lta bu'i srog gi gor// ye shes sems dpa' rdor sems tshon gang ba// dkar gsal rdor dril rin chen rgyan cha can// de yi thugs kar rin chen cha brgyad dbus// sran ma bkas pa tsam gyi nyi ma la// rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐// yungs 'bru tsam du phra zhing 'bar ba'i mthar// srog yig 'bru dgus g.yas su bskor ba'i sgo /rta mgrin dmar po pad+ma bhañja'i phyag /yum dang gnyis med 'khril bas bsrung bar bsam// de ltar rim gyis bskyed nas gcig char du gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku /ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las// 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa// sku yi dbyig tu bdag skyed cig /srog gi go ru shar ba dang*// snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya// zhes so// drug pa phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems 'od kyi gong bu las/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zung bcu gdan so so'i steng du mched de yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng phyogs nyi zla bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ mdzad sngo skya g.yas ser g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// rang rtags rgyal byed bar pas mda' gzhu 'gengs// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// sgra 'byin sngo skya g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar phyogs dri za bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rnam rgyal dkar po g.yas sngo g.yon ljang zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis 'khor lo tri shu la// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// mda' snyems dkar mo g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ shar lho me lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// dbyug sngon mthing ga g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis me dbal dbyug tho 'phyar// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// sder mo sngon mo g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho phyogs gshin rje bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// gshin rje sngo nag g.yas sngo g.yon ljang zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis dgra s+t+wa be con 'dzin// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// dur khrod sngon mo g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ lho nub srin po bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// mi g.yo ljang sngon g.yas sngo g.yon smug zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis ral gri zhags par bcas// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// gtun khung ljang mo g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo

/oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub phyogs chu lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rta mgrin dmar po g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis zhags pa spu gri 'dzin// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// gtum mo dmar mo g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men byi la pu shud mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nub byang rlung lha bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// 'dod rgyal dmar skya g.yas ser g.yon ljang zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis bhañja rnga yab 'phyar// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// mda' snyems dmar skya g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa lī hūm̐/ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// bdud rtsi ljang nag g.yas ser g.yon dud kha// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis rgya gram dbyug tos sdigs// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// rlung 'byin ljang nag g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men seng ge pha wang mgo /oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ byang shar dbang ldan bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// sum rgyal ser nag g.yas dkar g.yon ljang zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis mda' gzhu 'gengs la brtson// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// gsod byed ser nag g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men dom dang sre mong mgo

/oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'og phyogs sa bdag bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// stobs chen dud kha g.yas nag g.yon ser zhal// phyag drug dang pos rdo rjes bhan dmar dkrugs// bar pa'i phyag gnyis tho ba zhags pa bsnams// tha ma gnyis kyis drag po'i phur bu 'dril// skyod byed dud kha g.yon nas 'khril ba'i yum// g.yas pa dril 'khyud g.yon pa dung dmar stob// sprul pa'i phra men dred dang byi ba'i mgo /oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha kro dhī shwa rī/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ khro bo bcu po stangs stabs cha lugs dbyibs// gtso bo dang mtshungs yum rnams gtso mo'i tshul// za gsod rang rang khro bo'i mdog can g.yas// phur bu g.yon pa'i phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin// gcer bu rang rang khros pa'i bzhin ston cing*// dur khrod chas kyis rab brgyan 'phrul gyi gzugs// de rnams gsal gdab par bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ phyogs bcu dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// hūm̐ dang phaṭa sgrog srid gsum 'khor ba 'jig /bdud 'dul mthu chen khro rgyal yab yum bcu// za byed gsod byed gtum rngams tshogs bcas gsal// bdun pa phur bu rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ slar yang gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems 'od kyi gong bu las hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ mthing nag bdun mdun gyi zla gam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang nag bdun g.yas kyi zla gam/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dmar nag bdun g.yon gyi zla gam steng du spros te 'khod pa las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi rtse las phur bu phra mo dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khams gsum sems can thams cad kyi sgo gsum dang rigs drug gi bag chags snang zhen thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ thams cad dpal chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar 'dus hūm̐ yig rnams la thim ste yongs su gyur pa las sras mchog nyer gcig tu gyur pa ni/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kun kyang khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa// mdun gyi sras bdun mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal// g.yas kyi sras bdun ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal// g.yon gyi sras bdun dmar dkar ljang ba'i zhal// dang po'i phyag gnyis rtse dgu me dpung 'bar// bar pas rgya gram kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum bsnams// tha ma gnyis kyis phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs// sku smad chu srin kha las thon pa yi// gnam lcags rno dbal zur gsum bam ro yi// srog gi sgor btsugs dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// 'bar ba'i me 'od tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// snying rjes sgrol ba'i dam tshig kī la ya// zhes dang gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas// rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom// brgyad pa sgo skyong srung mar bcas pa bskyed pa ni/ slar yang gtso bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems 'od kyi gong bu las dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbazhi spros te sgo bzhir 'khod pa las/ tshad med bzhi dngos sgo ma bzhi// rta gdong dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin// phag gdong nag mo mche zhags thogs// nyi zla dmar mo dred gdong*/ lcags sgrog sdom// thal byed ljang khu spyang gdong*/ dril 'khrol dgyes// drag mo dur khrod rgyan cha can// thar pa chen po'i grong khyer gyi// sgo skyong rdo rje'i dam tshig ma// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ mo hā ghā ta ya ma ma shī gh+raṃ karma ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ dkyil 'khor bar khyams phyogs mtshams su// dpal chen dam tshig kī la ya'i// srung ma chen mo bcu gnyis dang*// bse lcags dung sogs ging chen bzhi// phyi yi 'khor yug lcags ri la// mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhi// dbang phyug nyer brgyad la sogs pa// rang rang cha byad lag char bcas// rgyan dang bgo ba bzhon pa 'khor// so so'i dam tshig bzhin ston pa// dam can 'khor yug gang bar gyur//

ces pas rje las 'bangs dang nyi ma las 'od zer bzhin mgron thabs su bskyed do// gnyis pa rang bzhin ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug pa la/ rang bzhin dgongs gsol spyan drangs la// phyag bya dbang zhu gnyis med bstim// sman gtor rak+ta dug gsum dang*// sbyor sgrol gyis mchod bstod bzlas bya// zhes bcu gnyis su gsungs pa las/ dang po dgongs gsol ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i 'od zer rang bzhin rdo rje phur bu'i zhing khams thams cad du khyab par 'phros pas/ srid pa'i phur bu gzugs kyi sku gang la gang 'dul gyi mos pa dang 'tsham par sad par bsam la/ hūm̐/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams// srid pa rdo rjer grub mdzod cig /srid pa rdo rje phur bu'i lha// ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod// oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor 'di la dgongs// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya e h+ye hi bha ga wān sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes pas/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la mngon du phyogs pas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ gsum pa phyag bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid gsum gdug pa 'dul ba dang*// nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir// rdo rje srin po'i lha tshogs la// rtse gcig yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū hoḥ pra tits+tsha hoḥ zhes pas yid rtse gcig tu 'dud cing rang bzhin gnyis med du rtogs pa'i tshul gyis so// bzhi pa dbang zhu ba ni/ hūm̐/ thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba// sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs mdzad nas// dbang dang byin rlabs bdag stsol cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ swā āṃḥhā/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

/khams gsum 'khor ba stongs bya'i phyir// dung chen snod du dmar chen bskyil// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal du 'bul// badz+ra kī la ya ma hā rak+ta khā hi/1$0000270 'khor ba khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho mchod par phul pas 'khor ba gnas nas stongs par 1$0000300 bsam/ dgu pa dug gsum mchod pa ni/ gti mug sha chen phungs se phung*// 'dod chags khrag mtsho me re re// zhe sdang rus gram nyi li li// dpal chen mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha raṃ khā hi/1$0000270 dug gsum rang gnas su dag par 1$0000300 bsam/ bcu pa sbyor sgrol mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas// lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha kha raṃ khā hi ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ cais 1$0000270shes rab dbyings kyi mkha' gru gsum du rig pa'i ye shes gtun shing gi sbyor bas dgra bgegs bsgral cing rtog tshogs dbyings su dag par sbyor 1$0000300 ba'o// bcu gcig pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dus gsum sangs rgyas ma lus 'dus pa'i dpal// rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// skye med rnam dag shes rab gsal ba'i don// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// sa bcu'i mnga' bdag zhing bcu tshar gcod dpal/ khro rgyal chen po bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod// pha rol phyin bcu'i rang bzhin shes rab dngos/ khro mo chen mo bcu la phyag 'tshal bstod// nyon mongs nyi shu gnas su sgrol mdzad pa/ khra thabs nyi shu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// thugs rje'i shugs kyis gnod gdug thams cad sgrol// sras mchog 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyi nang bar chad srung ba'i las la brtson// drag mo sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod// rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs dbang mo che// phur skyong srung ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/

bcu gnyis pa bzlas pa la lnga las/ dang po sku phyag rgya la dmigs pa'i dzap dgongs ni/ dkyil 'khor gsum spyi dang khyad par bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor yab yum zhal phyag rgyan cha phra mo'i bar gsal ba'i ngang nas ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bzlas pa'o// gnyis pa gsung yi ge la dmigs pa ni/ sngar bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi gsal snang brtan pa gzhir byas nas/ bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor sems dpa' sum brtsegs kyi ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig gi mthar kī la ya 'bru dgu ljang khu spus bris pa tsam g.yas skor du 'khod/ hūm̐ las 'od nyi zer lta bu 'phros/ khro bcu sras mchog sogs phyogs dus kyi rgyal ba sras bcas la mnyes mchod 'bul/ thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la phog /las dang nyon mongs rnam smin gyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ bde chen gyi zhing la bkod/ dam can srung ma'i tshogs la phog las la btsud/ rig 'dzin bla ma mched lcam la phog thugs dam bskangs/ dgra bgegs thams cad la phog gnod 'tshe gdug rtsub tshar bcad nas slar 'dus dkyil 'khor gsum la thim/ mthu bskyed/ dbang thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las kyi dngos grub thob par bsam la bzlas pa'o// gsum pa thugs chos nyid la dmigs pa ni/ thugs dmigs med nam mkha'i dkyil ltar dag pa rang bzhin gyis stong pa'i ngang las rig rtsal 'gag med dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum du gsal la rtog pa med par shar/ shar dus nyid nas rang bzhin med par dag pa/ skye med kyi ngang la rig pa 'dzin med tshogs drug lhug par bzhag ste bsam med mtha' bral dwangs sang nge ba'i ngang nas grags stong 'dzin med du bzla sa pa'o// bzhi pa yon tan la dmigs pa dbang dang dngos grub len pa'i dzap dang*/ lnga pa phrin las la dmigs pa spu gri'i sngags drug bzla tshul ni sgrub yig tu gsal lo// bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ

zhes pa bsnyen pa'i sngags te/ de yang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa la srog sngags 'bru dgu dang*/ sarba bigh+nān baṃ la las sngags 'bru lnga dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ la mkha' 'gro'i 'phyong sngags 'bru gsum ste/ de ltar na yi ge bcu bdun ni bsnyen pa'i sngags yin no// bsnyen tshad rab mtshan ma mngon du gyur pa gtso la/ grangs tshad bdun 'bum nyis khri zhes 'byung ngo*// bsnyen sgrub chig chod la drag sngags 'dus pa ste bsnyen sngags la sbrel nas bzla ste/ drag sngags 'dus pa ni/ ma rag mo yag mo: kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog la yaṃ yaṃ: snying la phril phril: srog la chum chum: tsit+ta srog la tung tung: snying khrag srog la shad shad: thuṃ ri li li: tseg tseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: gul gul: myags myags: sod sod: ḍā ki ma ma karma: shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye: mā ra se na: pra mār+dha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pa ste/ them yig las yi ge bdun cu rtsa drug tu 'byung ngo*// gsum pa rjes ni/ rjes tshogs bskul lhag smon lam gsol// gtor gtang dal bsdu rgyun ting bya'o// zhes pa ltar brgyad las/ dang po tshogs mchod la byin rlabs spyan 'dren mchod pa gsum las/ dang po byin rlabs ni/ dam rdzas su 'os pa'i yo byad ci 'byor pa bshams pa bdud rtsis bran la/ oṃ sarba dra byaṃ bi sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas spyir bsang*/ trāṃ rat+na trai lokya hūm̐ bh+rūm̐/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas tshogs gzhong rin po che'i mchod sdong 'dab ma stong ldan gyi snying por tshogs rdzas rnams nyi zla pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar bar gyur/ hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ byung ma dag pa'i dngos po thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus par bsam la/ gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ hūm̐/ rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis// chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig

/rig pa'i ye shes raṃ zhes bya// raṃ las ye shes me byung bas// phyi nang dngos por 'dzin pa kun// thams cad ma lus bsreg par bya'o// rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis// chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig /rig pa'i ye shes yaṃ zhes bya// yaṃ las ye shes rlung byung bas// rnam rtog dngos por 'dzin pa kun// thams cad ma lus gtor bar bya'o// rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes kyis// chos kun thams cad sgyu mar rig /rig pa'i ye shes khaṃ zhes bya/ khaṃ las ye shes chu byung bas// gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i bag chags kun// thams cad ma lus bkru bar bya'o// de nas/ hūm̐ mūṃ/ oṃ lāṃ/ swā māṃ/ āṃ pāṃ/ hā tāṃ/ rigs lnga yab yum gyi dam tshig chen po'i rang bzhin 'dod yon gyi rnam pa ci yang 'char bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañca a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhāḥ zhes byin gyis brlab bo// gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐/ srid pa'i phur bu sgrub pa dang*// dbang dang dngos grub blang ba'i phyir// zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa la// ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas 1$0000270rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang ba byon par 1$0000300 bsam mo// gsum pa mchod pa la spyi dang khyad par gyi mchod pa gnyis las/ dang po spyir mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' che// nam mkha' las ni 'dod pa 'byung*// 'dod yon mchod pa bzhes su gsol// oṃ/ gzugs ma lag gnyis me long thogs// gzugs mdzes bskyod pa phyogs bcur g.yo// shin tu sgeg pa'i gzi ldan 'bar// gzugs kyi lha mo spyan la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ rū pa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ/ sgra ma lag gnyis pi waṃ thogs// bden pa'i sgra snyan phyogs bcur g.yo// dbyangs snyan yid 'phrog 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sgra yi lha mo snyan la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ shab+da ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ

oṃ/ dri ma lag gnyis spos phor thogs// spos kyi sprin lding bdug pa mo// dri zhim spos kyi ngad ldang ma// dri yi lha mo shangs la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ gan+dhe ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ/ ro ma lag gnyis zas gzhong thogs// bcud len ro mchog lnga brgya ldan// kun tu ro mchog tshim byed ma// ro yi lha mo ljags la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ ra sa ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ/ reg gi lha mo yongs 'khyud ma// thugs ka dag nas yongs su 'khyud// kun tu reg bdes tshim byed ma// reg bya'i lha mo sku la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ spar+she ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ oṃ/ chos kyi lha mo pusti bsnams// yid ni tshim par byed pa ste// thams cad ma lus chos kyi dbyings// chos kyi lha mo thugs la thim// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta naṃ dharma ga ṇa tsakra pū dza me gha pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes 'dod yon lngas spyir mchod nas/ tshogs rdzas thun mong du btegs la/ hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di// ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te// bla ma yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī ga ṇa tsakra khā hi/ zhes 'bul zhing spro na skabs 'dir skong ba'i las rim gsum yang bya'o// gnyis pa bye brag tu mchod pa ni/ mchod bshags bsgral stob gsum ste/ tshogs phud rim pa gsum du spros la/ dang po mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// phyag brnyan chen po'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// shwa na mu kha'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// sa bdag chen mo'i dus la bab// tshogs phud mchod pa bzhes su gsol// badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā hi/

zhes mchod/ bar pa bshags pa ni/ ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de yi 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin rnams// mi yi skyon mthong tsam na bar chad rtsom// bdag cag ma rig sgo gsum bag med pas// 'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs byas bshags// tshogs kyis mchod do tshangs dbang dngos grub stsol// sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha s+t+waṃ/ tha ma bsgral ba ni/ brub khung du liṅga bcas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ dgra bgegs mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer ljang nag ba thag gzengs pa lta bu phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i rtse las sras mchog lta bu'i khro bo'i sprul pa dpag tu med pa 'phros/ stong gsum thams cad gang*/ snang ba sku /sgra grags gsung*/ rtog tshogs thugs su gsal bas bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs/ srung ma dam can rnams las la bskul/ rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi g.yar dam sor bstsal/ rigs drug bla med kyi gnas su spar/ khyad par bsgral bya'i gnas su 'phros/ rang dbang med par bkug ste liṅga la thim/ 'od zer slar 'dus rang dang gdab phur la thim pas gzi brjid dang mthu stobs dpag tu med par

bsam la/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid gdod nas stongs kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ khyad par bcom ldan 'das dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis brdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig / ces bden stobs brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dgra bgegs gnod byed dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shī gh+raṃ ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces dgug gzhug byas nas/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// sprul pa chen po'i dus la bab// phyag brnyan chen po'i dus= shwa na mu kha'i dus= bdag nyid chen mo'i dus= sa bdag chen mo'i dus= khyed kyi phrin las dus= mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab// ces pho nya bskul/ hūm̐/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i// rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni// gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis// yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas// mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang*// lus ngag rdul du bshig nas kyang*// sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nān/

mo hā gha ta ya/ bha ga wān/ hrīḥṣ+ṭiḥbi krita shrī badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sarba bigh+nān/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ a phaṭa/ ces bzla bzhin du phur bu bsgril zhing gdab ste/ de yang bdag dpal chen po/ phur bu sras mchog /liṅga gnod byed kun 'dus su gsal bas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas a dkar po dpag tu med pa byung*/ rang gi snying gar a gcig tu gyur pa'i 'od zer gyis sku gsung thugs 'od gsal bar byas/ liṅga la phog /sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ snying gar tshe rten a 'od kyi thig le'i dbus su kun gzhi nṛ dud kha'i gzugs su gnas pa la/ phur rtser hūm̐ ldan btab pas nṛ thig le a bcas hūm̐ la bsdus/ phur rtse a dkar ye re ba de rang la bstan pas bdag gi rdo rje'i tshe srog dang gnyis su med pa'i byang chub kyi sems su gyur/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ brjod cing phur bu'i dbal nas bzung ste klad la bskor bas khams gsum phur bus gang*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum phur bus gang ba la phog /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas slar 'dus/ bdag la thim/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ slar yang hūm̐ las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse las dmigs bya'i rnam shes a yig gi gzugs kyis 'og min du spar/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rdor sems yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su thim/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rdor sems kyi sras su skyes par bsam pa ni brten pa dbyings su bsgral ba'o// slar yang bag chags kyi rten gzhi bsgral ba'i phyir/ dngos grub bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams// zungs shig rgyob cig rnam par chings// gtogs shig grogs dang bral bar gyis// rings par khug la smrar chugs shig

/phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis// nga yi dbang du gyur nas kyang*// bsgo ba'i bka' la mnyan par byos// snyems ma'i phur bu lte bar gdab la hūm̐ pa ra bid+yā/ sder mo snying la ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dur khrod ma dang gtum mo dpung pa gnyis la bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtun khung ma dang mda' snyems ma pus mo gnyis la gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ rlung 'byin ma gsang bar ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ gsod byed ma mgo la bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gab pa'i sngags drug ni trā sha ya trā sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ha sa ya ra ha sa ya ra hrīḥdaṇ+ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa/ shī gh+raṃ a nā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dz+wa la pa ya dz+wa la pa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā be sha ya ā be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ bhin+dha ya bin+dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing khro mo so so'i phur bu yod na dang*/ gcig las med kyang de dang der mos la rang sngags kyis gnas so sor gdab bo// bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyed kyi dam tshig dus la bab// sngon chad khas blangs dam bcas bzhin// mngon spyod phrin las grub par mdzod// rnam rgyal gyi phur bu dpral bar gdab la ha na ha na badz+ra/ dbyug sngon dpung g.yon da ha da ha badz+ra/ gshin rje lte bar pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ mi g.yo dpyi g.yon ma thā ma thā badz+ra/ rta mgrin mgrin par dz+wa la dz+wa la badz+ra/ 'dod rgyal dpyi g.yas su ru su ru badz+ra/ hūm̐ mdzad spyi bo mu ru mu ru badz+ra/ stobs chen gsang gnas ka ṭaṃ ka ṭa ye/ sum rgyal dpung g.yas dza ye bi dza ye/ 'khyil pa snying gar a dzi te a pa ra dzi te/ mā ra se na pra mar+dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces sngar bzhin khro bo bcu'i phur bu gnas so sor gdab cing 1$0000270spu gri'i sngags 1$0000300 kyis thun rdzas sna tshogs pas kyang brab bo// gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi// lha 'am 'on te bdud kyang rung*// nga la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos//

sgra 'byin ma'i phur pa spyi bor gdab la sarba ā na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ skyod byed ma rkang mthil du gdab la ta thā ya ta thā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces steng 'og gi phur bu spyi gtsug dang rkang mthil du btab pas 'khor 'das kyi mtha' bsal lo// rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' las ni// sdig can gang zhig 'da' byed pa// stobs chen khro bo chen po yis// klad pa tshal pa brgya ru khos// nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed// hūm̐ ma ma pā shaṃ ku ru ma taṃ ny+ya ka ra i dan dha ti ma ma shī gh+raṃ ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char bab par bsam la ral gris gtub bo// rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di// rdo rje me dbal snying bsregs nas// lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du rlogs/ khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje tho bas brdungs byas nas// lha yang rung ste bsgral bar bya// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces 1$0000250tho gtun yab yum gyi mkha' gsang dbyings rig gi sbyor bas gzugs phung zag med kyi dbyings su bcom par 1$0000300 bsam la tho bas brdung ngo*// snyigs ma'i lus bdud rtsir sbar pa gtor mar bstabs la/ hūm̐/ dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig /dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i lnga phung 'di// dpal chen yab yum zhal du stob/ khro rgyal yab yum zhal du stob// sras mchog 'bar ba'i zhal du stob// za gsod sgo ma'i zhal= mkha' 'gro ging tshogs zhal= sdang dgra gdon bgegs 'khor bcas rnams// rdul phran tsam yang med par rol// badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes phul bas/ dgyes par rol te ha ha ha zhes bzhad/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes dngos grub bstsal nas 'od gsal du zhu/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces de las sad pa'i snang cha chos nyid bden pa'i ngang bskyang ngo*// gnyis pa bcol bskul bya ba ni/

pho nya 'dus pas gtso bo'i phur bu 'dril/ bshugs pas 'bod cing rnga thabs dang bstun la/ hūm̐ dzaḥ dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab// ces sogs bab brgyad kyis pho nya bskul nas/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing*// sogs phrin las bcol ba las rim drug gi sngags rnams dor la gong bzhin drag tu brjod pas bskul lo// de yang tshogs tha mar phur gdab kyis brten pa bsgral ba tsam gyi mthar bstab pa sbyar na gong gi bcol bskul nges par bya zhing*/ gdab kha rdzogs par byas na bcol bskul ma byas kyang chog go /de nas las kyi rdo rjes rdo rje rgyal po la phyag byas dza gad dang māṃ sa bsnol mar stob cing*/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol// zhes rim bzhin drang*/ a la la hoḥ zhes brjod cing blangs la/ 1$0000270bdag rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rtsa ba gsum 'dus su gsal btab 1$0000300 ste/ bdud rtsi'i longs spyod tha mal gyi zhen chags dang bral bas bde ba chen por rol zhing spyod do// gsum pa lhag ma'i cho ga ni/ lhag ma bsdus nas/ phud so sor bshams la sman raka bran te/ hūm̐/ dang po phud kyis mi mchod du// rdo rje gzhon nu phud kyi bdag /bar du sprin ltar mi gtib tu// dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnyen gyi bka'// tha ma gcig tu mi bsre ru// ma tshogs dbang phyug lhag ma'i gnas// lhag ma kha chus mi gdab tu/ khyod dang nged gnyis dam tshig gcig /ye nas 'du 'bral med don du// 'dus la las rnams kun byos shig / ces brjod nas phud lhag bsres/ kha phru dang bdud rtsis bran la/ hūm̐/ bran dang bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ khyod kyi dam tshig dus la bab// sngon chad ji ltar dam bcas pa'i// mngon spyod 'phrin las grub par mdzod// lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bstan pa gnyan po bsrung du gsol// ma hā pañca a mṛta khā hi/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ bud+dha ḍā ki nī/

badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ rat+na ḍā ki nī/ pad+ma ḍā ki nī/ karma sarba ḍā ki nī kha kha khā hi khā hi/ kiṃ ka ra ma hā pañca ba lin+ta khā hi/ zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas gtor ma phyi rol du dor ro// bzhi pa smon lam gdab pa ni/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo/ chos nyid kyi bden pa'o// gsang sngags kyi byin gyi brlab bo// sangs rgyas kyi mthu'o// a bhi tsar+ya'i dus la bab bo// brnag pa de kho na la'o// de ltar gsang sngags kyi spyod pa rmad du byung ba spyad pa'i mthu byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la longs spyod cing skal pa mnyam par gyur cig / ces smon lam gdab/ lnga pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ hoḥ dpal chen po'i lha tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol/ ta na sgrol ba gnas su ma stob pa dang/ ga ṇa sbyor ba byin gyis ma rlob pa dang*/ mchod sngags ting 'dzin ma dag cing nyams pa dang*/ dge ba bcu dang du ma longs shing mi dge ba bcu rtsad nas ma chod pa dang*/ bka' bzhin gzhung ma bsrangs pa dang*/ dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag nyams chag tu gyur pa ci mchis pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags na bzod pa dam pa mdzad du gsol/ tshe 'di'i rkyen dang phyi ma'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bar tshangs pa dam pa stsol bar ci gnang*/ zhes gsol zhing yi ge brgya pa brjod do// drug pa gtor ma gtong ba la gsum las/ dang po brtan ma bskyang ba ni/ gtor ma phyir bsnur la sman raka sbreng zhing*/ hūm̐/ brtan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas/ khyed cag sngon gyi yal gam can// slob dpon pad+ma thod phreng dang*// slob ma rlangs chen dpal seng gis// mon kha ne ring rdzong gsum du// zhing chen bsgral ba'i gdan steng du// rnal 'byor gral la bzhag nas ni// thar pa thob pa'i mtshan yang btags// sgrub pa po la phan gdags phyir// bran gyi tshul du khas blangs na// dam las ma 'da' da tshur spyon// bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la// bcol pa'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod//

ces bskul la gtor ma gza' rgyu phyogs dang bstun te gtong*/ gnyis pa zor du bskul pa ni/ skabs ji lta bar de nyid shes pas gtor ma mtshon cha'i phung por bsgyur la/ hūm̐/ dgra bo'i yul du dmag 'dren no// dmag dpon rdo rje gzhon nus mdzod// dmag sna khro bcus phyogs bcur drongs// sgo bzhi ma mos dmag dpung sdus// ging chen jag pa phyogs bcur khyes// gnod byed dgra bgegs bla khug la// sras mchog nyer gcig gtor zor rgyob/ khrag zor phur zor rdo zor dang*// mda' zor thun zor dug zor rgyob// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ma rag+mo 'i rjes la/ dgra bgegs sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad bh+yoḥ zhes dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ dul mo brdab 1$0000270dam can pho mo'i dmag tshogs kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pas dgra bgegs kyi lnga phung rdul du brlags par 1$0000300 bsam mo// gsum pa bro brdung ba ni/ gtor gzhong ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam la/ yi dam lha'i stangs stabs kyis/ hūm̐/ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// dbus phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// nyi zla bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// rdo rje gzhon nu'i bro ra bcas// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad// zhal gsum phur pa'i dzap zlos shing*// phyag drug 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha bsnams// zhabs bzhi phur bu'i 'od zer 'phros// sku la dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// gshog pa rdo rje'i bu yug 'tshub// rang gi lha dang lha mo yang*// ma bskyed par yang dbyings su 'du// sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs// ma bkug par yang dbang du 'du// lta ba chos nyid kī la ya// snang srid phur btab kī la ya// lta bas chos nyid zin pa la// srid pa g.yo 'gul ming yang med// snang srid phur bus thebs pa la// dgra bgegs g.yo 'gul ming yang med// rkang pa g.yas pas bro brdungs pas// rdo rje gzhon nu thabs kyi bro// rkang pa g.yon pas bro brdungs pas// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs shes rab bro// thabs shes dbyer med bro brdungs pas// dgra ni dum bur gtub pa'i bro// bdud ni phye mar 'thag pa'i bro// dam sri thal bar rlog pa'i bro// 'byung po rdul du rlog pa'i bro// oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+wam+bha ya nan/

ya ma dam sri nā ga rā tsa dzaḥnan/ zhes mnan no// bdun pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas snang srid 'od du zhu ba gzhal yas khang la thim/ gzhal yas khang 'khor gyi lha tshogs la thim/ 'khor rnams rim gyis gtso bo la/ gtso bo ye shes sems dpa' la/ ye shes sems dpa' thugs srog hūm̐ la/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs thig ler yal ba'i ngang du mi dmigs par bzhag pas rtag mtha' bsal lo// brgyad pa rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin ni/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ stong gsal gyi ngang nas bdag lus chu las nya ldang ba'i tshul du rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi skur langs te snod bcud lha'i 'khor lor sbyang zhing 'dod yon gyi rol pa mtha' dag mchod pa chen po'i dam tshig tu spyad pas chad pa'i mtha' bsal nas zung 'jug gi ting nge 'dzin chu bo'i rgyun lta bu la sbyar ro// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes khrag 'thung dpal// rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo cher// yongs shar sgrub pa'i lam bzang bka' gter gyi// chos tshul rgya mtsho'i snying po bla na med// phur bu'i mdo tig dril ba rtsa ba dang*// spu grir 'brel ba yang snying gsang sgrub kyi// las gzhung o rgyan mkhan po'i mgul khug nas// phyung ste klu bdud lto bar sbas pa gang*// thugs gter bka' babs chos kyi dbang phyug gis// zab gter sgo brgya phyes las skal bzang 'gror// grub gnyis 'dod pa 'jo ba'i yid bzhin nor// bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'di nyid byung*// gang gi phrin las dam pa'i zhal gyi lung*// bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kun bzang rol pa'i mtshor// slar yang 'khyil 'dis don gnyer skal ldan la// dngos grub rin chen 'byung gnas nyid du mtshon// 'dis thob bsod nams mkha' mnyam srid pa'i 'gro /sku bzhi'i bdag nyid rdo rje phur bu yi// 'khor lor yongs dag lam bzang mchog 'di yang*// phyogs dus kun tu 'phel zhing rgyas par shog
